France / Burgundy Glazed Tile

Burgundian glaze. Pale stone. Satin brass.

Preparing the local 3D asset…

Cosmetic lid movement only. This is one inner collectible, not the outer custody container. No transaction or custody state changes.

About this study

Editable, procedurally authored Blender geometry inspired by Burgundy’s polychrome glazed-tile tradition. Not an exact reconstruction or hand-sculpted work.

Model and poster are embedded locally. Nothing is minted, on-chain, signed or hosted. Proposed launch: 201 one-of-one Boxes, each with the same edition scarcity. Accessories are a later separate collection; certificates would be signed records, not independent NFTs.
